topic: HA LLM API versus selectable Tool Provider
note: Before implementing an Assist tool, distinguish contributing a tool through async_get_tools to an existing API from registering a standalone API with async_register_api. A tool contributed to the built-in Assist API will not appear as its own entry in the conversation agent's Tool Providers list. When a selectable provider is required, subclass API, register it during integration setup, unregister it with the config entry lifecycle, and verify the provider appears in the UI. Follow the naming requirements for the chosen registration path; domain-prefixed tool names apply to contributed tools.
